address: Dafna Street, Area 61, 801 Building 138,, Doha, Qatar
bio: Come for their tasty kung pao chicken, stay for their zodiac-inspired cocktails at the bar. This plush and intimate restaurant in the heart of the city makes a great spot for a romantic evening out. The décor’s 1930’s feel, its moody ambiance and the elegantly dressed team all complement the mix of dishes hailing from China and Japan. Modern and classic dishes go hand in hand, such silver cod with yuzu miso and wonderfully flavourful short rib gyoza, along with dim sum and sushi....
